lines.text: Some editors call it cheating. A video, made from a few sentences.
The accusation? The AI did the work. No timeline. No keyframes. No late nights.
Every new editing tool got the same reaction. Cutting on a computer. Templates. Presets.
And the AI still can't pick the story, the moment, or the feeling. You do.
So, is it cheating? Only if you stop thinking.
Comment your verdict, and join vibe editing.
